cases.name: shares
cases.query:
SELECT Region, AGG(Umsatz), AGG(UmsatzanteilDerAuswahl), AGG(UmsatzanteilAllerRegionen)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01' AND Region = 'North'
GROUP BY Region
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql

/** DML_CALENDAR { pk(dt_date) } **/
/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/*------------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       measure                      **/
/*------------------------------------------------------*/

/** #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925 { pk(Region, dt_month) } **/
if object_id(N'tempdb..#DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925', N'U') is not null drop table #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925;
select
    region as Region,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as Umsatz,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as Umsatz_minus_dim_Region,
    (SUM(amount)) / nullif(SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month), 0) as UmsatzanteilDerAuswahl
into #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
    and region = 'North'
group by region, dt_month;

create unique clustered index idx__R_dm
	on #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925
	   (Region, dt_month);

/** DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_24FB925 { pk(Region, dt_month) } **/
with DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_24FB925 as (
select
    region as Region,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as Umsatz,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as Umsatz_minus_dim_Region
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by region, dt_month
),

/** DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_B2FE925 { pk(Region, dt_month) } **/
DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_B2FE925 as (
select
    t.Region,
    t.dt_month,
    tf210a.Umsatz / nullif(t.Umsatz_minus_dim_Region, 0) as UmsatzanteilAllerRegionen
from DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_24FB925 t
left join #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925 tf210a 
	on (tf210a.Region = t.Region or (tf210a.Region is null and t.Region is null))
	and (tf210a.dt_month = t.dt_month or (tf210a.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
)


/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       query                       **/
/*-----------------------------------------------------*/

select
    coalesce(t1.Region, t2.Region) as Region,
    t1.Umsatz,
    t1.UmsatzanteilDerAuswahl,
    t2.UmsatzanteilAllerRegionen
from #DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_A2B4925 t1
full outer join DML_VERKAUFSPOSITIONEN_BY_R_DM_B2FE925 t2
    on (t2.Region = t1.Region or (t2.Region is null and t1.Region is null))
    and (t2.dt_month = t1.dt_month or (t2.dt_month is null and t1.dt_month is null))
where coalesce(t1.Region, t2.Region) = 'North'
order by Region;
